description: Regression: in ODC an entity attribute is born with an IRecordAttributeValue (the value of the sample record, which SS11 calls SampleRecord). It is maintained and cleared by Studio itself, so it counts as DERIVED use: deleting an attribute without an author consumer must pass WITHOUT force. Without that rule, no entity attribute could be deleted in the ODC lane.

ops._why: only the sample record value, which is derived
without an author consumer: passes without force
the attribute that remains keeps its own derived value
